corpus_definition: The 15 works in the reference list of the supplied narrative review, enriched with OpenAlex metadata.
research_question: For four review-grounded topic queries over the review's 15 cited works, how does adding an OpenAlex citation-count prior to BM25 affect Recall@5 for manually annotated relevant references, especially the lowest-citation third of the corpus?

citation_prior.transform: log1p(cited_by_count), min-max normalized over the 15-work corpus

citation_strata: Sort the 15 works by OpenAlex cited_by_count ascending, then reference ID; assign five each to low, medium, and high. This is corpus-relative, not a global percentile.

metrics.recall_at_5: Relevant references in top 5 divided by all relevant references for that query; higher is better.
metrics.precision_at_5: Relevant references in top 5 divided by 5; higher is better.
metrics.ndcg_at_5: Binary-gain nDCG over top 5; higher is better.
metrics.mrr: Reciprocal rank of first relevant reference; higher is better.
metrics.low_citation_recall_at_5: Recall@5 among gold references in the corpus-relative low citation stratum; higher is better.
metrics.mean_log_citations_top_5: Mean log1p OpenAlex citation count of the top 5; descriptive visibility measure, not a relevance metric.

queries.text: citation bias in large language model recommendations of scholarly papers, citation counts, and human citation patterns
queries.annotation_basis: Review Sections 3.1 and 7, Table 2, and references [2], [8], [15]: LLM citation recommendation bias and the Matthew effect.

queries.text: language bias and non-English studies in systematic reviews, multilingual screening, and translation-free multilingual abstracts
queries.annotation_basis: Review Sections 3.2 and 5, Table 2, and references [5], [9], [12], [14]: multilingual screening, non-English review inclusion, and linguistic bias.

queries.text: large language models screening titles and abstracts for eligible systematic review studies, sensitivity, specificity, and false negatives
queries.annotation_basis: Review Section 4.3 and Table 2, references [3], [4], [5], [7], [13]: LLM-assisted screening and its sensitivity/workload evidence.

queries.text: retrieval augmented generation for scientific literature review search, ranking, source attribution, and corpus feedback
queries.annotation_basis: Review Section 4.2, Sections 7.1 and 9.2-9.4, Table 2, references [1], [6], [11]: literature-review retrieval, RAG, and test-time corpus feedback.

pre_run_decision_rule: Report a citation-prior trade-off descriptively if the primary lambda=0.25 system has higher mean log citation count in its top five than both lexical baselines and lower low-citation Recall@5 than both. Do not infer statistical significance or generalize beyond this corpus.
